definitions.explanation: Completely eliminating something undesirable so that it cannot recur. Used for diseases, social problems, crime, and harmful practices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{貧困|ひんこん}→貧困：04836_hinkon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根絶|こんぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧。
⟦{感染症|かんせんしょう}→感染症：15681_kansenshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根絶|こんぜつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: Eradicating infectious diseases takes a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{根絶|こんぜつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that education is the most important thing for eradicating discrimination.

notes:
USAGE:
A strong, formal word typically used in public discourse, policy, and media. Implies total and permanent elimination, not just reduction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {根絶|こんぜつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to eradicate)
- {根絶|こんぜつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{目指|めざ}す→目指す：10528_mezasu⟧ (to aim for eradication)
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{根絶|こんぜつ} (eradication of disease)
- {根絶|こんぜつ}やし (completely wiping out — emphatic colloquial form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{撲滅|ぼくめつ}→撲滅：19614_bokumetsu⟧: eradication; stamping out — similar strength, often used for crime, drugs, and social evils
- ⟦{排除|はいじょ}→排除：07631_haijo⟧: exclusion; removal — less absolute, means removing rather than completely destroying
